about_the_game:
Mini Painter is a cozy desktop idle game about finding balance between work and rest.

Immerse yourself in a meditative world where a tiny artist paints miniature figures, decorates his home, and learns to take care of himself.


Upgrade the room, collect geeky items, and keep your little painter inspired.
The more inspiration he has, the better his miniatures will turn out.

Each painted figure brings you closer to the final goal: the opus magnum that's been gathering dust on the shelf, waiting for its moment.

Features:

  • Unhurried progress: take your time creating the perfect geeky room.

  • Work and rest balance: don't overwork your artist, or he'll burn out. But don't let him relax too much either, or he'll lose his motivation.

  • Pack opening: discover rare or even unique miniatures. Complete special collections and make your little artist truly happy.

  • Skill growth: the more experienced your character becomes, the more vibrant and valuable his creations will be.

  • Pixel art in isometric view: bringing the cozy spirit of the early 2000s to your desktop.

  • Around 200 hours of meditative gameplay.

Give your little artist the chance to complete his greatest masterpiece.
